description: This file defines a utility enum `WindowPlacement` in Swift, containing static methods for calculating window frame positions such as centering, positioning in the top right corner, anchored below another rect, and ensuring on-screen placement. It is used in the context of macOS window management, leveraging AppKit frameworks.

methods.name: centeredFrame(size:on:)
methods.description: Computes a frame centered within the specified screen or bounds.

methods.name: topRightFrame(size:padding:on:)
methods.description: Calculates frame positioning in the top-right corner with specified padding.

methods.name: centeredFrame(size:in:)
methods.description: Returns a frame centered within given bounds.

methods.name: topRightFrame(size:padding:in:)
methods.description: Returns a frame positioned at the top-right within given bounds.

methods.name: anchoredBelowFrame(size:anchor:padding:in:)
methods.description: Positions a frame below a specified anchor rect, ensuring it stays within bounds.

methods.name: ensureOnScreen(window:defaultSize:fallback:)
methods.description: Adjusts a window's frame to ensure it is visible on some screen, defaults to centering if off-screen.
